sections.heading: 1. Acceptance and Scope
sections.paragraph: By using Ghost Tunnel, you agree to these Terms and related policies.
bullets: Applies to visitors, hosts, and participants.
You must have legal authority to accept these Terms.
Stop using the service if you do not agree.

sections.heading: 2. Responsible Use
sections.paragraph: You must use the service lawfully and responsibly.
bullets: Do not abuse, harass, or threaten others.
Do not distribute malware or perform attacks.
Do not attempt to bypass security controls.

sections.heading: 3. Security and Encryption
sections.paragraph: The service is designed for encrypted communication, but no system is perfect.
bullets: Keep room credentials and keys private.
Compromised devices can expose content.
Users are responsible for endpoint security.

sections.heading: 4. Content and Rights
sections.paragraph: You are responsible for the content you send or upload.
bullets: You must own or have rights to shared content.
Illegal or infringing content is prohibited.
Platform branding and code remain protected.

sections.heading: 5. Host Controls
sections.paragraph: Hosts can moderate room behavior for safety and governance.
bullets: Hosts may approve or reject requests.
Hosts may lock rooms or mute users.
Misuse of controls may be restricted.

sections.heading: 6. Service Availability
sections.paragraph: Features may change or be interrupted for maintenance or security.
bullets: Downtime may occur without prior notice.
Features may vary by browser and device.
We may modify or discontinue features.

sections.heading: 7. Liability and Disclaimers
sections.paragraph: The service is provided "as is" and "as available".
bullets: No guarantee of uninterrupted operation.
No guarantee of complete security in all scenarios.
Indirect or consequential damages are disclaimed where allowed by law.

sections.heading: 8. Updates to Terms
sections.paragraph: We may revise these Terms to reflect legal, technical, or product changes.
bullets: Updated versions become effective when posted.
Continued use means acceptance of updates.
Review this page regularly.

sections.heading: 1. Scope
sections.paragraph: This policy explains how data is handled across landing, policy, and chat paths.
bullets: Applies to hosts and participants.
Applies to desktop and mobile browsers.
Covers product security features.

sections.heading: 2. Data Categories
sections.paragraph: We process technical and operational data needed to run the service.
bullets: Session and connection metadata.
Room-level control events.
Encrypted message and media payloads.

sections.heading: 3. Processing Purpose
sections.paragraph: Data is processed to provide secure communication and product reliability.
bullets: Deliver room and messaging functionality.
Support moderation and safety controls.
Detect abuse and troubleshoot failures.

sections.heading: 4. Encryption Model
sections.paragraph: Content is intended to be encrypted client-side before transmission.
bullets: Plaintext handling is minimized.
Key secrecy remains user responsibility.
Endpoint compromise can still create risk.

sections.heading: 5. Retention
sections.paragraph: Retention is limited to operational and security requirements.
bullets: Temporary room state may be purged.
Host actions may affect data lifecycle.
Security diagnostics may be retained briefly.

sections.heading: 6. Security Safeguards
sections.paragraph: We use technical and organizational safeguards to reduce risk.
bullets: Client-side encryption workflows.
Room moderation and access controls.
Monitoring for suspicious behavior patterns.

sections.heading: 7. User Rights and Choices
sections.paragraph: You may have legal rights depending on your jurisdiction.
bullets: Access, correction, and deletion rights may apply.
You can clear local browser data at any time.
You may stop using the service at any time.

sections.heading: 8. Policy Updates
sections.paragraph: This policy may be updated as legal or product requirements evolve.
bullets: Updates are effective when posted.
Please review this page periodically.
Continued use means acceptance of updates.
